subject: 4CH1
skill: Count atoms in a supplied molecular formula, multiply by supplied relative atomic masses and add the contributions.

customQuiz.rationale: Retain two original marks only. Four distinct element contributions are retained, but easier counts, structure context and presentation require independent difficulty and response calibration. No four/six-mark adaptation.

requirements: Supply a neutral aminoalkanoic-acid molecular formula derived privately from H2N-(CH2)n-C(=O)-OH, integer n1..10. The learner need not recall this substance or the homologous relationship.
Show every C/H/N/O subscript clearly and provide C12,H1,N14,O16 in an explicit relative-atomic-mass table.
Ask for dimensionless relative formula mass, with space for working. No molar-mass unit, empirical-formula, percentage-composition or unknown product demand.
evidenceContract: Freeze atom counts, atomic-mass table, exact sum, source-specific credit policy and original prompt before any answer.
Do not expose answer, seed, parameters, solution or marking criteria in a public question.
Offline experimental generator and bounded structured-transcription marker only; not imported by live sessions.

constraints: The neutral open-chain structure fixes all atom counts; do not sample arbitrary impossible CHNO formulas.
This deliberately bounded domain contains ten formula variants, not an unlimited bank.
Use C=n+1,H=2n+3,N=1,O=2; nitrogen is a neutral NH2 end group and COOH is the other end group.
Never substitute original caffeine C8H10N4O2 as a fresh generated item.
Four element terms do not prove equal difficulty to the caffeine source. Ten candidate variants require further breadth before live practice.
No active or validated status before generator, notation, response and mark-adaptation calibration.
relationships: Correct final result can receive both source marks without working; no source ECF from a wrong formula or atomic mass.
difficultyControls: Single N and fixed O2 make some terms easier than the source; empirical demand equivalence remains unverified.
Subscript typography, atomic-mass lookup and arithmetic size require learner trials.

transformations.conditions: n1..10 preserves neutral valence and CHNO contributions; difficulty and response calibration pending.
Each added demand or different maximum needs a separately reviewed contract.

solutionProcedure: Read the supplied atom counts and supplied relative atomic masses.
Write the sum of atom-count × relative-mass products for all four elements.
Evaluate the exact integer sum; relative formula mass is dimensionless.

criteria.rule: One mark for the complete correct numerical substitution of all atom counts and supplied relative atomic masses.
One further mark for the correct sum. The source awards both marks for a correct final answer without working; preserve that concession.

acceptableAlternatives: Reordered additions/products and equivalent unambiguous arithmetic forms.
Correct final result alone receives two marks under the source concession; ambiguous or contradictory additional evidence needs review.
dependencies: The correct-answer-without-working concession is not a generic automatic M2-subsumes-M1 dependency.
No ECF from incorrect formula or relative atomic masses. A correct substitution with evaluation error can retain the method mark.
contradictionRules: No universal extra-answer, unit or working penalty is invented from examiner advice. Conflicting evidence requires source-policy review before automated marking.

commonErrors.description: Omitting an atom contribution, using atomic numbers, or applying an unnecessary further operation.
Treating Mr as a mass in grams rather than a relative quantity.

testPlan: Check all ten proposed parameter values against independent atom counting and exact arithmetic.
Before implementation, calibrate method-only, result-only, alternative notation, contradictory responses, typography and difficulty.

runtime.seedPolicy: Unsigned32-bit seed modulo10 plus1 selects n. Seeds repeat after ten variants; no infinite uniqueness claim.

blockers: Only ten related formula variants; source difficulty equivalence and sufficient bank breadth are unverified.
Offline marker supports structured transcriptions only; free-text/handwriting and contradictory-response calibration unfinished.
No student rendering/layout calibration, validated custom marks or live registration.
Official per-leaf AO allocation unverified. DeepSeek runner is prepared but no provider calls occurred without credentials.
